devdoc.details: This is a contract that implements the core functionality of the xBIFKN314 token. The contract is used to create a token that can be used for liquidity provision and swapping. It follows the Automated Market Maker (AMM) model using the constant product formula. The contract allows users to add and remove liquidity, swap tokens, and perform flash swaps. The contract also accrues fees and distributes them to the feeTo address. The contract is initialized with a supply cap. The contract also maintains a reference to the xBIFKN314LP contract for LP token management. The contract allows for a factory address of address(0) to be set, which will disable fee distribution. The contract owner can set the trading fee rate, maximum wallet percentage, and metadata URI. The contract owner can also enable trading, set the fee collector address, and claim accrued trading fees.

AddressEmptyCode(address).details: There's no code at `target` (it is not a contract).

AddressInsufficientBalance(address).details: The ETH balance of the account is not enough to perform the operation.

AutoSwapPrevented().details: Thrown when an operation tries to perform an auto-swap and it is prevented for the caller.

CheckpointUnorderedInsertion().details: A value was attempted to be inserted on a past checkpoint.

ECDSAInvalidSignatureLength(uint256).details: The signature has an invalid length.

ECDSAInvalidSignatureS(bytes32).details: The signature has an S value that is in the upper half order.

ERC20ExceededSafeSupply(uint256,uint256).details: Total supply cap has been exceeded, introducing a risk of votes overflowing.

ERC20InsufficientAllowance(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `spender`’s `allowance`. Used in transfers.

params.allowance: Amount of tokens a `spender` is allowed to operate with.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC20InsufficientBalance(address,uint256.details: Indicates an error related to the current `balance` of a `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.balance: Current balance for the interacting account.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC20InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSpender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `spender` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC4626ExceededMaxDeposit(address,uint25.details: Attempted to deposit more assets than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxMint(address,uint256,u.details: Attempted to mint more shares than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxRedeem(address,uint256.details: Attempted to redeem more shares than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxWithdraw(address,uint2.details: Attempted to withdraw more assets than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC5805FutureLookup(uint256,uint48).details: Lookup to future votes is not available.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

FailedInnerCall().details: A call to an address target failed. The target may have reverted.

InvalidAccountNonce(address,uint256).details: The nonce used for an `account` is not the expected current nonce.

SafeCastOverflowedUintDowncast(uint8,uin.details: Value doesn't fit in an uint of `bits` size.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC20 token failed.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

DelegateChanged(address,address,address).details: Emitted when an account changes their delegate.

DelegateVotesChanged(address,uint256,uin.details: Emitted when a token transfer or delegate change results in changes to a delegate's number of voting units.

EIP712DomainChanged().details: MAY be emitted to signal that the domain could have changed.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

CLOCK_MODE().details: Machine-readable description of the clock as specified in EIP-6372.

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().details: Returns the domain separator used in the encoding of the signature for {permit}, as defined by {EIP712}.

addLiquidity(uint256,address,uint256).details: Adds liquidity to the contract by depositing tokens and native currency.

params.amountToken_: The amount of tokens to be deposited.
params.deadline: The deadline in unix time from the current timestamp for the transaction to occur.
params.recipient: The address of the recipient of the liquidity tokens.

returns.liquidity: The amount of liquidity tokens minted.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

claimFees().details: Allows the fee collector to claim accrued trading fees. The function transfers the accrued native currency and token trading fees to the fee collector. The accrued amounts are reset to zero after the transfer. Emits a `FeesCollected` event with the fee collector's address, accrued native amount, and accrued token amount. Requirements: - The caller must be the fee collector.

clock().details: Clock used for flagging checkpoints. Can be overridden to implement timestamp based checkpoints (and voting), in which case {CLOCK_MODE} should be overridden as well to match.

constructor.details: Constructor for the xBIFKN314 contract. It initializes the ERC4626 vault with a name and symbol and deploys a new LP token contract.

params.factoryAddress_: The address of the factory contract.
params.name_: The name of the ERC4626 vault.
params.symbol_: The symbol of the ERC4626 vault.
params.underlyingAsset_: The underlying asset for the ERC4626 vault.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. This function overrides the `decimals` function from both ERC4626 and ERC20. It calls the `super.decimals()` method to get the decimals value from the parent contracts.

delegate(address).details: Delegates votes from the sender to `delegatee`.

delegates(address).details: Returns the delegate that `account` has chosen.

deposit(uint256,address).details: Overrides the deposit function from the inherited contract. Adds the deposit amount to the contract and mints shares to the recipient.

params.assets: The amount of tokens to be deposited.
params.receiver: The address of the recipient of the shares.

returns.shares: The number of share tokens minted.

depositRewards(uint256).details: This function allows anyone to deposit rewards into the vault and ensure they are managed by the strategy.    If a strategy is set, the rewards are deposited into the strategy.    If no strategy is set, the rewards are held in the vault.

params.amount: The amount of rewards to deposit. Requirements: - The amount to deposit must be greater than zero. Emits: - `RewardsDeposited` event indicating the amount of rewards deposited. - `RewardsHeldInVault` event indicating the amount of rewards held in the vault.

getAmountIn(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: Calculates the input amount and factory fee based on the output amount, output reserve, and input reserve. This accounts for all fees including the factory fee, trading fee, and base swap rate.

getAmountOut(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: Calculates the amount of output tokens based on the input amount and reserves. This accounts for all fees including the factory fee, trading fee, and base swap rate.

params.inputReserve: The amount of input tokens in the reserve.
params.outputReserve: The amount of output tokens in the reserve.

getAmountsForLP(uint256).details: Gets the amount of tokens held by the liquidity provider.

params.amount: The amount of liquidity tokens to be converted.

returns.nativeAmount: The amount of native currency held by the liquidity provider.
returns.tokenAmount: The amount of tokens held by the liquidity provider.

getPastTotalSupply(uint256).details: Returns the total supply of votes available at a specific moment in the past. If the `clock()` is configured to use block numbers, this will return the value at the end of the corresponding block. NOTE: This value is the sum of all available votes, which is not necessarily the sum of all delegated votes. Votes that have not been delegated are still part of total supply, even though they would not participate in a vote. Requirements: - `timepoint` must be in the past. If operating using block numbers, the block must be already mined.

getPastVotes(address,uint256).details: Returns the amount of votes that `account` had at a specific moment in the past. If the `clock()` is configured to use block numbers, this will return the value at the end of the corresponding block. Requirements: - `timepoint` must be in the past. If operating using block numbers, the block must be already mined.

getReserves().details: Returns the reserves of the contract. If the fees are greater than the reserves, the function returns 0 for the respective reserve.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getTokensInContract().details: Returns the number of tokens held by the contract.

returns.tokenBalance: The token balance of the contract.

getVotes(address).details: Returns the current amount of votes that `account` has.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

mint(uint256,address).details: Overrides the mint function from the inherited contract. Mints shares to the recipient and updates the rewards.

params.receiver: The address of the recipient of the shares.
params.shares: The number of shares to be minted.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

pause().details: Pauses the contract. Can only be called by an account with the VAULT_MANAGER_ROLE.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over ``owner``'s tokens, given ``owner``'s signed approval. IMPORTANT: The same issues {IERC20-approve} has related to transaction ordering also apply here. Emits an {Approval} event. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `deadline` must be a timestamp in the future. - `v`, `r` and `s` must be a valid `secp256k1` signature from `owner` over the EIP712-formatted function arguments. - the signature must use ``owner``'s current nonce (see {nonces}). For more information on the signature format, see the https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2612#specification[relevant EIP section]. CAUTION: See Security Considerations above.

redeem(uint256,address,address).details: Overrides the redeem function from the inherited contract. Burns the shares from the sender and transfers the assets to the recipient.

params.owner_: The address of the owner of the shares.
params.receiver: The address of the recipient of the assets.
params.shares: The number of shares to be redeemed.

removeLiquidity(uint256,address,uint256).details: Removes liquidity from the contract by transferring native currency and tokens back to the liquidity provider.

params.amount: The amount of liquidity to be removed.
params.deadline: The deadline in unix time from the current timestamp for the transaction to occur.
params.recipient: The address of the recipient of the native currency and tokens.

returns.nativeAmount: The amount of native currency received.

removeStrategy().details: This function allows the VAULT_MANAGER_ROLE to remove the strategy from the vault.     It is intended for emergency use only and should be used with caution.     This will leave all funds that are in the strategy there and will need to be handled manually. Requirements: - Only the owner can call this function. - The function is protected against reentrancy attacks. Emits: - `StrategyUpdated` event indicating the change in strategy.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setMaxWalletEnabled(bool).details: Enables or disables the maximum wallet limit.

params.enabled: The boolean value to set the maximum wallet limit. Requirements: - Only the contract owner can call this function.

setMaxWalletExempt(address,bool).details: Sets the maximum wallet exemption status for a given address.

params.addressToChange: The address for which the maximum wallet exemption status is to be set.
params.isExempt: A boolean value indicating whether the address should be exempt from the maximum wallet limit. Only the contract owner can call this function. Requirements: - The address to change cannot be the zero address, the contract address, or the dead address.

params.maxWalletPercent_: The maximum wallet percentage to be set. Requirements: - `maxWalletPercent_` must be less than or equal to 10000 (100%) and greater than 0 if maxWalletEnabled is true. Only the contract owner can call this function.

setMetadataURI(string).details: Sets the metadata URI for the token.

params.newURI: The new metadata URI to be set. Requirements: - Only the contract owner can call this function.

setTradingEnabled().details: Enables trading by setting the `tradingEnabled` flag to true. Can only be called by the contract owner. Once trading is enabled, it cannot be disabled.

setTradingFeeRate(uint256).details: Sets the fee rate for trading.

params.feeRate: The new fee rate to be set. Requirements: - `feeRate` must be less than or equal to 50 (5%). Only the contract owner can call this function.

params.deadline: The deadline in unix time from current timestamp for the swap to occur.
params.minimumTokensOut: The minimum amount of tokens to receive in the swap.

swapTokenToNative(uint256,uint256,uint25.details: Swaps a specified amount of tokens for native currency.

params.deadline: The deadline in unix time from current timestamp for the swap to occur.
params.minimumNativeOut: The minimum amount of native currency expected to be received.
params.tokensSold: The amount of tokens to be sold.

sweepDust(address).custom:reverts: VaultNotEmpty if the total supply is not zero.
sweepDust(address).details: This function can only be called by an account with the VAULT_MANAGER_ROLE.

params.to: The address to which the remaining balance of the asset will be transferred.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

totalAssets().details: This function overrides the totalAssets function from the parent contract.

returns._0: The total amount of assets managed by the vault and the strategy.

totalSupply().details: Returns the total supply of the token. This function overrides the totalSupply function from ERC20, IERC20, and xBIFKN314Rewards.

returns._0: uint256 The total supply of the token.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Transfers tokens from the sender to the recipient. Overrides the transfer function from the inherited contract. If the recipient is this contract and autoSwap is not prevented, then it automatically swaps tokens to native currency. Otherwise, calls the transfer function from the inherited contract.

params.value: The amount of tokens to transfer.

returns._0: success A boolean indicating the success of the transfer.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers tokens from one address to another using an allowance. Overrides the transferFrom function from the inherited contract. Includes a max wallet check to ensure the recipient's balance does not exceed the limit.

params.value: The amount of tokens to transfer.

returns._0: success A boolean indicating the success of the transfer.

unpause().details: Unpauses the contract. Can only be called by an account with the VAULT_MANAGER_ROLE.

updateStrategy(address).details: This function handles the migration of funds from the current strategy to a new one.      If the new strategy is set to `address(0)`, it disables the strategy and retains funds in the vault.      The function ensures all funds are safely withdrawn from the old strategy before switching to the new strategy.

params.newStrategy: The address of the new strategy to set. Use `address(0)` to disable the strategy. Requirements: - Only the owner can call this function. - The function is protected against reentrancy attacks. Emits: - `StrategyUpdated` event indicating the change in strategy.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).details: Overrides the withdraw function from the inherited contract. Burns the shares from the sender and transfers the assets to the recipient.

params.assets: The amount of assets to be withdrawn.
params.owner_: The address of the owner of the shares.
params.receiver: The address of the recipient of the assets.

BASE_SWAP_RATE.details: The base swap rate for the contract. It represents a 0.3% fee for each swap.

DEAD_ADDRESS.details: Represents the address constant for the dead address. The dead address is a predefined address with all zeros, used to represent an address that is no longer in use or has been destroyed.

MAX_FEE_RATE.details: The MAX_FEE_RATE constant represents the maximum fee rate that can be set. It is set to 500, which corresponds to a fee rate of 5%.

MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY.details: The minimum liquidity required for a transaction.

SCALE_FACTOR.details: The SCALE_FACTOR constant represents the scaling factor used in the contract. It is set to 10000.

accruedNativeFactoryFees.details: Public variable to store the accrued native fees.

accruedNativeTradingFees.details: Public variable to store the accrued trading fees.

accruedTokenFactoryFees.details: Public variable to store the amount of accrued token fees.

accruedTokenTradingFees.details: Public variable to store the accrued token trading fees.

blockTimestampLast.details: Represents the timestamp of the last block for enabling twap

factory.details: The address of the factory contract.

isInitialized.details: A public boolean variable that indicates whether the contract is initialized or not.

isMaxWalletExempt.details: A mapping that stores whether an address is exempt from the maximum wallet limit.

liquidityToken.details: Represents the LP token contract for the BIFKN314 contract.

maxWalletEnabled.details: A boolean variable that indicates whether the maximum wallet limit is enabled or not.

maxWalletPercent.details: The maximum percentage of the total supply that a wallet can hold. For example, a value of 100 represents 1% of the total supply.

metadataURI.details: Represents the metadata URI for the contract.

owner.details: The owner of the contract. For IERC314 compliance.

price0CumulativeLast.details: Represents the last cumulative price of the native asset.

price1CumulativeLast.details: Represents the last cumulative price of the token.

strategy.details: This variable holds the strategy that will be used for certain operations within the contract.

tradingEnabled.details: A boolean variable indicating whether trading is enabled or not. Once trading is enabled, it cannot be disabled. Trading must be enabled before users can swap tokens. Trading can only be enabled by the contract owner. Trading is disabled by default.

tradingFeeRate.details: The tradingFeeRate variable represents the rate at which trading fees are charged. It is a public variable, meaning it can be accessed and modified by other contracts and external accounts. The value of tradingFeeRate is a uint256, which represents a non-negative integer. If the value of tradingFeeRate is 0, no trading fees are charged. 15 represents a trading fee of 0.15%. 100 represents a trading fee of 1%. If the value of tradingFeeRate is 500, a trading fee of 5% is charged.

constructor.notice: The factory address must be a valid address.

removeLiquidity(uint256,address,uint256).notice: The liquidity provider must have sufficient liquidity balance.

removeStrategy().notice: Removes the strategy from the vault, disabling the strategy and retaining funds in the vault.

setMaxWalletExempt(address,bool).notice: If the address to change is the zero address, the contract address, or the dead address, the transaction will revert.

strategy().notice: The strategy associated with this contract.

sweepDust(address).notice: Transfers any remaining balance of the asset to the specified address if the vault is empty.

totalAssets().notice: Returns the total assets managed by the vault, including those managed by the strategy.

updateStrategy(address).notice: Updates the strategy used by the vault, migrating all funds from the current strategy to the new one.
